name: graphql-automation-pack
description: GraphQL API automation pack for the Rick and Morty API using Playwright TypeScript and Cucumber

scripts.test:bdd: mkdir -p bdd-results allure-results/bdd && GRAPHQL_RUNNER=bdd ALLURE_RESULTS_DIR=allure-results/bdd cucumber-js --require-module ts-node/register --require bdd/steps/**/*.ts --format progress --format json:bdd-results/cucumber-report.json --format allure-cucumberjs/reporter bdd/features/**/*.feature
scripts.test:all: npm run prepare:run && npm run discover && npm run test:nonbdd && npm run test:bdd
scripts.validate: npm run test:all && npm run report:custom
